scientific_integrity: The primary paper already supplies the clique characterization and a four-agent counterexample; lower-role welfare subcases already have exact published solutions. The present claim is the unbounded-family full Nash-stability census, all-size Nash optimum and robust separation. Finite checks support but do not prove the theorem. Independent scientific and historical-priority audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric aversion-to-enemies unit friendship and large enemy cost on an exact complete split friendship graph; unrestricted unilateral Nash deviations; optimization over individually rational partitions; no general weighted or incomplete-core graph statement.
title: Exact Nash-stability census and a welfare separation on core–periphery friendship graphs
